ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (13) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Сыны бога» (syny boga, 'sons of God') is restored where the site draft had 'children', and «осуществлять» (osushchestvlyat', 'to realize') is kept as 'realize' each time. The pronouns «ты» (ty) and «вы» (vy) are rendered 'the familiar “you”' and 'the polite “you”'; the Gospel echo «кто соблазнит одного из малых сих» (kto soblaznit odnogo iz malykh sikh) is translated from Tolstoy's wording as 'whoever tempts one of these little ones', after «соблазн» (soblazn, 'temptation').
